about.p3: Our team of certified specialists guarantees compliance with all applicable regulatory requirements and European quality standards.

faq.title: EXPERT ANSWERS
faq.description: Important information about the regulatory framework and technical maintenance
faq.q1: How often is it mandatory to carry out maintenance of the equipment?
faq.a1: According to the current regulatory framework in Bulgaria (Regulation No. 8121з-647), each fire extinguisher must undergo a mandatory technical inspection at least once every 12 months. After successfully passing the test from a licensed service, the device receives an up-to-date holographic sticker and is entered in the fire safety log of the site.
faq.q2: What is the most suitable type of extinguishing agent for administrative and commercial premises?
faq.a2: See Appendix No. 2 to Regulation Iз-1971.
faq.q3: Is it necessary to fully recharge the device after partial use?
faq.a3: Absolutely yes. Even with a very short press of the trigger and minimal pressure release, the tightness of the valve is broken. The pressure will drop completely in the following hours or days. Such a device is considered faulty and must be immediately handed over to a service for full cleaning, recharging and sealing.
faq.q4: What are the mandatory documents that form the company's fire safety file?
faq.q5: When is a device subject to decommissioning and what is its service life?
faq.a5: The metal body of powder and water fire extinguishers is subject to mandatory hydraulic strength test every 10 years. Upon successful test, the service life can be extended. In the presence of visible deep corrosion, impact deformations, cracks or failed hydraulic test, the device is dangerous for use and is immediately decommissioned.
